messages:
elaine (sec): FYI: started seeing SCIM duplicates for ~20 users after yesterday's IdP change. Noticing different external_id hashes in our audit logs :eyes:
ryan (sre): can you paste an example log line?
elaine (sec): here, redacted:
```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z INFO scim-provision user=alice@example.com external_id_hash=sha256:3f7a... kms_key_alias=alias/prov-2024 action=create
```
elaine (sec): and another for the same email but different hash a minute later
```
2026-03-21T14:03:05Z INFO scim-provision user=alice@example.com external_id_hash=sha256:9c2b... kms_key_alias=alias/prov-2024 action=create
```
elaine (sec): they end up as two distinct service accounts in our DB (external_id used as uniqueness).
sasha (idp): last night we changed the NameID format from transient->persistent to address-based (per compliance request). Could break canonicalization.
ryan (sre): ok that explains it — external_id is derived from SAML NameID and then encrypted/hmaced with KMS. If NameID format changed, the preimage changed -> different hashes.
mike (platform): is the KMS key rotating? alias/prov-2024 is stable, no recent rotations in key manager logs.
elaine (sec): auditsvc-bot shows a KMS decrypt error spike around the same time (but most decrypts succeeded).
auditsvc-bot: 14:02:50Z ALERT audit:scim:decrypt-failure count=7 source=eu-prod region
ryan (sre): mitigation idea: treat email as canonical for now (fallback) and run a dedupe job to merge impacted accounts. Need approval from compliance for using email lookup.
sasha (idp): we can temporarily revert NameID to transient->persistent mapping while we triage, but that will conflict with the compliance ticket.
elaine (sec): for incident timeline & audit we should snapshot current provisioning DB, export all create events for the window 13:50-14:10 UTC. I'll open a ticket.
mike (platform): action items:
- flip platform flag allow_externalid_fallback=true (short-lived)
- schedule dedupe job: scim_dedupe_by_email.sh (dry-run)
- collect SAML assertion samples from IdP logs (sasha)
- check KMS key usage metrics (ryan)

ryan (sre): dedupe dry-run command:
```
./bin/scim_dedupe --dry-run --start 2026-03-21T13:50:00Z --end 2026-03-21T14:10:00Z > /tmp/dedupe-dryrun.log
```
sasha (idp): grabbing assertion samples now, will DM the encrypted bundle to elaine.
elaine (sec): compliance: ping @compliance on Slack — we need signoff to use email fallback and to perform account merges. Also note potential audit impact due to KMS decrypt spikes.
ryan (sre): preliminary root cause hypothesis: NameID format shift changed the canonical external_id preimage. KMS decrypt anomalies may be unrelated but amplify timing. We should test KMS decrypts against both preimage variants and confirm stable alias mapping.
mike (platform): also adding a feature flag to preserve a historical external_id mapping table for future migrations.
elaine (sec): if compliance approves, we'll roll the fallback flag, run dedupe dry-run, then actual run during low-traffic window. Keep this thread updated with timestamps of each action. :thumbsup:
ryan (sre): doing KMS checks now, will report in 10m.
sasha (idp): ETA on revert plan is 30m if needed.
elaine (sec): thanks — tagging this for incident postmortem later.
